title: CENTRAL STAIRWAY

texts.text: This architectural drawing sheet presents cross-sections and floor plans for the Iolani Palace in Honolulu, Hawaii, specifically focusing on the central stairway. The document includes detailed elevations facing Punchbowl Street and Hotel Street, along with plans for the first, second, and basement floors, illustrating the building's multi-level structure and staircase design.
